units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 20:1">Pesik. R. s. 20</cite> <he>הראהו ארבע צ׳ וכ׳</he> he showed him the four colors in the Tabernacle (<cite ref="Exodus 26:1">Ex. XXVI, 1</cite>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 7:7:2">Y. Keth. VII, 31ᶜ</cite> <he>נדרה … בגדי צ׳</he> if a woman vows … not to wear dyed (expensive) clothes; <he>כלי פשתן … ככלי צ׳ הן</he> the fine linen garments from Beth Shean are like dyed clothes (included in the vow).

<cite ref="Shabbat 57b:13">Sabb. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>עניות עושין אותן של מיני צ׳ עשירות וכ׳</he> poor women make them (those garlands) of dyed wool, the rich of silver or gold; Y. ib. VI, 7ᵈ <he>צובעין תותבן</he>, read: <he>צבעונין או זהובין</he>.
